Game Overview

In Bloom in the Dark, the core idea is straightforward: guide a bird through a monochrome world, collecting precious water droplets to nurture a lonely flower. Navigate intricate levels across 12 stages with nostalgic 1-bit charm and captivating platform puzzles, bringing life to the shadows.

How to Play

Bloom in the Dark keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Guide a bird through a monochrome world, collecting precious water droplets to nurture a lonely flower. Navigate intricate levels across 12 stages with nostalgic 1-bit charm and captivating platform puzzles, bringing life to the shadows.
